ابتلعوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَعُوا (ibtalaʕū) /ib.ta.la.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اُبْتُلِعُوا (ubtuliʕū) /ub.tu.li.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اِبْتَلِعُوا (ibtaliʕū) /ib.ta.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
